sentences.en: Kabyle, Shawi and Riffian are all mutually intelligible Berber variants.
sentences.zh: 卡比勒语、沙威语和里夫语都是可以相互理解的不同柏柏尔语变体。

sentences.en: Many of the most concerning variants share the same mutations.
sentences.zh: 许多最令人担忧的变体都共享相同的突变。

sentences.en: His latest musical pieces are just variants of his earlier work.
sentences.zh: 他最新的音乐作品只是对早期作品的一些变体。

senses.zh: 变种，变形；（单词拼写或读音的）变异，变体
